steps.name: a_dialog_grouped
steps.desc: The New map dialog with the user library alienworld installed: core's biomes under 'Start from' (the library name at the end of the line), then a field headed 'Alien World' with its one biome, version and author at the end of the line

steps.name: b_dialog_library_pick
steps.desc: The library's tile picked: the core tiles let go, the ground caption follows the library biome

steps.name: c_core_only_home
steps.desc: A new 150 ft map from the core temperate forest, seed 1234, home view, before any painting

steps.name: d_two_libraries_home
steps.desc: The same map with the right third painted with alienworld's Red Mesa (biome id alienworld__red_mesa_summer_s1, assets copied from core's badlands onto a green alpine ground): the core forest to the left, the second library to the right

steps.name: e_boundary_close
steps.desc: Size 16 across the seam between the core forest and the second library's biome

steps.title: Content library step S4: a second library next to core
steps.intro: alienworld is a user library in user://libraries (version 0.3.1, depends on core ^1.0, one biome: red_mesa, with plants copied from plantgen's core library on an alpine-green ground). It is found by the registry at start-up, its biome is served as alienworld__red_mesa_summer_s1, and a new map is painted with it beside the core temperate forest. a/b: the New map dialog grouped by library. c/d/e: the map. The probe's lines in log.txt show the libraries list, the libraries the map records and the manifest the save wrote (format 3). Nothing is saved except the _libs4_two level, deleted at the end.
